messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPEN - GEN-502 - eu-west-1 p99 tail latency elevated. Paging primary oncall. Severity: S2. Link: <https://incidents.internal/GEN-502|GEN-502>
Alex Chen: taking this. TL;DR: p99 generation latency in eu-west spikes ~3x last 45m, tail at ~18s. Error rate is low (~0.5% 5xx) but queueing/backpressure causing long tails for large-context requests. Customer-facing impact: interactive generation latency for a subset of EU customers and a couple of support tickets (TKT-892, TKT-899).
Alex Chen: current actions:
- scaled model-pool-gen-eu to +25% via autoscale override
- rolled a subset of workers to pick up new kernel build (attempt to reduce CPU contention)
- enabled regional fallback for non-EU-data-sovereign traffic to us-east-1 (routing flag: fallback:us-east)
- applied short token-bucket per-key rate-limit for anonymous keys: 20req/min
- disabled prefetch for heavy ops on the queue
Maya Patel: noted. did you see correlation with KV eviction alerts earlier? I saw a burst of kv.evictions around 23:10 UTC.
Alex Chen: yes, correlation looks real — KV cache burst + increased GC on a few nodes. root cause still unknown, probably a combination of request pattern and a mem leak in a worker. logs I pulled:
```
[2026-03-14T23:12:07Z] model-worker-74 CPU 98% span=gen(>4k)
[2026-03-14T23:12:12Z] kv-store evict key=ctx/large-req size=12MB
[2026-03-14T23:12:13Z] queue-length gen-eu 142 -> 220
```
Alex Chen: mitigation notes in runbook: /runbooks/kv-eviction-response and /runbooks/generation-tail-latency
Maya Patel: ok. handing off in 20m — I need to jump to another pager. priority for next oncall:
- keep watch on p95/p99 for gen-eu
- if p99 > 15s for >10min, escalate to SRE infra (Priya)
- check for growing queue length in both master and sharded queues
- if errors > 2% or 5xx spikes, consider rollback to previous model kernel using canary route
Maya Patel: sticky tasks:
- confirm fallback routing isn't affecting latency for US origin customers
- follow up with infra if mem pressure on kv nodes persists after the next 2 restarts
- keep TKT-892/899 updated with ETA
Alex Chen: adding a small helper command for next oncall to re-open a scaled override if needed:
```
# raise gen-eu pool by 4 nodes (k8s)
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-pool-gen-eu --replicas=12
# revert routing flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://routing.internal/flags -d '{"fallback":"none"}'
```
Priya Singh: FYI infra alerting is on — I'm watching the KV cluster. If evictions continue after two restarts, we'll migrate a shard off the most noisy host. ETA for a shard migration is ~25-30m.
Alex Chen: note: cost spike since routing fallback to us-east increases cross-region egress. keep an eye on cost metrics: console > billing > live
Maya Patel: handing over now. @Jamal — you good to be primary for the next shift? overlap 30m here.
Jamal Rivera: got it, I'm taking primary. I'll be online for the overlap. My immediate plan:
- validate current mitigations (scale, rate-limit, disabled prefetch)
- watch queue and kv evictions every 5m
- if p99 remains > 12s after 30m, run a rolling restart of remaining eu worker pool (careful with concurrency)
- contact infra if evictions still spike after rolling restart
Jamal Rivera: escalation contacts: Priya (SRE infra), @alex (model runtime), oncall-ecs (for k8s node issues). Pager duty: escalate to team 'infra' if S3 (severity) triggers or manual escalation per runbook.
Alex Chen: a couple of quick things for next: do not change model weights or kernel versions unilaterally — we observed regressions earlier. prefer traffic routing and pool sizing first.
Oncall Bot: update GEN-502 - severity unchanged. New alert: kv.evictions count increased by +12 in last 10m. Next status update in 15m or on notable change.
Jamal Rivera: acknowledged. I'll post a status update to incident channel every 15m. Contact me in Slack or Pager if anything urgent.
Maya Patel: thanks @Jamal. leaving notes: tickets TKT-892/899 updated with current mitigations. customers notified: cust-acme (informational), cust-zeppelin (may see degraded latency).
Alex Chen: closing my shift. if anyone needs the debug gather again, command is `./tools/collect-debug --incident GEN-502 --target eu-west` and it uploads to the incident folder.
Jamal Rivera: taking over — watchlist: p95, p99, queue-length, kv.evictions, 5xx%. If you see new customer reports escalate immediately. I'll be primary until 03:30 UTC. Secondary: Priya.
Priya Singh: I'll remain on standby. If we need shard migration, I'll kick it off.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT NOTE: handoff completed. Primary: Jamal Rivera. Secondary: Priya Singh. Handoff overlap: 30 minutes. Link: <https://incidents.internal/GEN-502|GEN-502>
